.²1 A golden coin (of different values, but generally taken to be equal
 to one {%Karṣa%} or Suvarṇa of 16 Māṣas); {#varAwakAnAM daSakadvayaM#}
 {#yat sA kAkiRI tASca paRaScatasraH . te zoqaSa dramma ihAvagamyo drammEstaTA#}
 {#zoqaSaBiSca nizkaH .. mAMsaBettA tu zazRizkAn#} ({#daRqaH#}) <ls>Ms. 8. 284</ls>.
.²2 A weight of gold equal to 108 or 150 Suvarṇas <ab>q. v.</ab>
.²3 A golden ornament for the neck or the breast; {#haricakreRa tenAsya#}
 {#kaRWe nizkamivArpitam#} <ls>Ku. 2. 49</ls>; {#nizkakaRWIH#} ({#upadevavarastriyaH#})
 <ls>Bhāg. 4. 3. 6</ls>.
.²4 Gold in general.
.²5 A golden vessel.
.²6 A die or dice; <ls>L. D. B.</ls>
.²7 Departure, going away; <ls>Nm.</ls>
